title: pi-gwn-tec: Physical knowledge improves ionospheric electron content forecasts as model input rather than as loss penalty
description: Code for the article Physical knowledge improves ionospheric electron content forecasts as model input rather than as loss penalty (Xiong et al.): Graph WaveNet and SimVP forecast models, the physical inputs, loss penalties and structural priors compared in the article, the multi-family ensemble, the regional models for China and Japan, interval calibration, scoring, one configuration file per configuration and a script that recomputes the reported tables from daily statistics. See README.md.
